info.name: COMP3123 Assignment 1 API
info.description:
Run the whole collection in order with the Collection Runner.

Each run creates two fresh users (User A and User B) using a unique runId, so the collection can be run again.

The last folder intentionally triggers the login rate limit (429). Restart the server before running the collection again, otherwise login keeps returning 429 for 15 minutes.

exec: pm.test("Owner is set from the token", () => pm.expect(body.employee.user).to.be.a("string"));

item.name: 4. Employees - User B
item.description: User B creates their own employee.

exec: pm.test("Does not contain User A employees", () => pm.expect(ids).to.not.include(pm.collectionVariables.get("empA1")));

item.name: 5. Ownership - cross-user access
item.description: Each user tries to read, update and delete the other user's employee. All attempts must be rejected with 403.

item.name: User A gets User B employee
User A updates User B employee
User A deletes User B employee
User B gets User A employee
User B updates User A employee
User B deletes User A employee

exec: pm.test("Salary not changed by User B", () => pm.expect(body.employee.salary).to.eql(90000));

item.name: 6. JWT errors
item.description: Protected endpoints with missing, malformed or invalid tokens.

item.name: 8. Rate limiting (run last)
item.description: Repeats a wrong-password login until the server answers 429. Restart the server before running the collection again.
